objective_value: <float> For TSP, the total closed-tour distance (minimize). For MaxCut, the number or total weight of cut edges (maximize).
solution: <dict> Dense binary decision vector. For TSP use every key 'x_{city}_{time_step}' (or every flat index) for all n_cities squared variables. For MaxCut use every key 'x_{node}' (or every flat node index), where 0/1 identifies the side of the cut.
tour: <list[int], condition: problem_type == 'TSP'> Required only for TSP: the length-n_cities permutation derived from the one-hot solution variables. Omit for MaxCut.
